defect: A fill acknowledged while a cold tenure's first capture pass is in flight is in neither the published checkpoint nor the suffix; the successor's warm load opens without it.

property.text: a retained entry outside every damage set was lost on host loss

note: Cause, evidence and catch set by M1-2 (#318); bug issue #316. The fill publication's commit reads `capture.suffix.required()` in `install`; the capture pass walks the membership in `Storage::capture_visit` (crates/kestrike/src/storage/capture.rs). The comment in `Storage::cut_intact` (storage/capture.rs) states the guarantee for a fill the membership at the proof holds. quint/suffix.qnt, invariant Retained, guarantees the entries of the last durable live set; after a pass publishes, that set is the pass's snapshot at the cut until a later block completes, and the model always stages a suffix record for a fill, so it does not model the first pass's unrequired suffix. Whether a fill acknowledged between the first pass's cut and its proof is owed is the question disagreement-first-pass-fills records, and that row stays open until the owner answers. A defect of its own, not a pair of ivk-2317.

evidence.steps: The trigger needs a cold first tenure whose record names no checkpoint, a fill acknowledged while its first capture pass is in flight, the pass published and the suffix opened, and a successor that attaches the same media warm. Before this unit no listed history or swept profile issued a capture pass with a warm load: `rg -ln 'start_capture|cut_intact|WarmSource|warm_device' crates/kestrike/src/net/world_tests crates/kestrike/src/sim` lists only `net/world_tests/relaunch.rs` and `histories/warm_loads.rs`, the warm relaunch of the history world this unit adds, so no other listed history or swept profile starts a capture pass and attaches a successor warm. The takeover history cycles (`net/takeover_history_tests/cycles.rs`) and the worker case of publishing restart cycles (`host/duties_step_tests.rs`) combine a capture pass with a warm attach outside the sweep; they are no swept profile, and whether they run this trigger's sequence was not checked. The history wl2-fill-in-pass-lost runs those steps; its sibling wl2-fill-before-pass, with key 2 filled before the pass starts, passes.
evidence.sweep: One sweep at 8b58f1355 of cluster-swarm, cluster-pressure and upload, archive build f86c52457e1cf9a27b5576cc1d5f79004cef8b7b3d48413c21d64c13344047bd, campaign bsw-ct1-2100-profiles, 28 workers, 121 s, counts {}: cluster-swarm 13835 runs (0..13834), 10660 pass, 3175 uncredited, 0 suspects; cluster-pressure 34895 runs (0..34894), 34437 pass, 458 uncredited, 0 suspects; upload 399266 runs (0..399265), 399266 pass, 0 uncredited, 0 suspects; controls 4466 runs, 3299 caught, 0 missed; 79 replays, 0 suspects, none of class replay differs. Every run of the three profiles reaches the steps above at most in part: no profile of the set starts a capture pass and attaches a successor warm.
